plaatsen.tekst: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian
And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
